title: Sam Morgan's band and his drummers
summary: Labat calls Sam Morgan's band his favorite, recalls the Monday pavilion concerts, Isaiah Morgan, Joe Watson's clarinet lesson and drummer Alfred Williams.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why
